name: Mud cracks 8: algae
description: Plant cells: the layer shrinks along one direction first and across it later, so the first walls run side by side and the ones that follow split each cell across, ending in T-junctions; as it grows, cells keep dividing, each generation of walls thinner. Paint district to turn the cells' direction, cross_lag for how long the first walls run alone, grow, dry, grip or toughness. Takes a while to start: the layer has to dry quite a lot before the first cracks.
